brief:
Hamas accused Israel on Monday of attempting to destroy evidence of "brutal crimes" against Palestinians in Gaza during the war that has lasted over two years, Middle East Eye reported. The militant group characterized the alleged efforts as an attempt at "obliterating evidence" as the conflict continued without resolution.

Hamas did not specify which evidence Israel allegedly sought to conceal or identify the particular crimes in question. The accusation underscores deepening disputes over documentation and accountability related to the lengthy Gaza conflict.
